content_zh:
第3章夜里哭闹不止
“不去不去，你去找别人吧。”
“不走，这大晚上的谁没事去那啊！”
这是嫌自己命长还是嫌自己运气不够差？
丧葬一条街又叫南清街，是江渝市出了名的“怪”
街。
早些年大家都叫它丧葬一条街，因为整条街都是卖各类丧葬用品的店铺而出名，街上还有几间风水铺子，需要各类产品和服务的人都习惯去那里，因此街上店铺生意都还不错。
但是三年前开始，丧葬一条街就开始怪事频出了。
白天还好，一切正常，做生意的做生意，买东西的买东西，可一到晚上，街上就会出现一些无法用科学解释的事件。
比如说晚上街上会莫名其妙响起哭啼声，结果住在街上的店家出来看，街上却空无一人，就连监控也拍不到。
大晚上会有穿白裙的女人在街上散步，可那女人却是没有脚的。
店里的香烛总是会在半夜消失不见......
总之各种五花八门的怪事都冒出来了，街上的商家们也害怕啊，没多久就搬走的搬走，实在舍不得这生意的，也都只在白天卖东西，一到天快黑的时候立马关门离开。
但即使白天没发生过什么事情，这条街也逐渐人走楼空，现在只剩几家靠近街口的店铺还开着，却没什么生意。
人气少了，整条街白天也都显得阴森森的。
渐渐地，当地人都有了一个共同的认知，那就是有事没事绝对不要去丧葬一条街，尤其是晚上！
这群司机们有一个夜车队聊天群，之前群里就有一个胆大的司机不信邪，非要去那条街夜探，结果晚上八九点开进去，一直到第二天天亮才开出来。
要知道丧葬一条街只是一条不过几百米长的直街，且道路平缓，白天从街头开到街尾只需要一分钟不到，那司机却足足开了一整晚的车都没开出来，还是第二天天亮了才惊觉出口竟然就在自己前方。
开了一整晚，油没了不说，人更是被吓得不轻，足足在家里歇了大半个月才缓过神来。
这件事情之后，司机们更是对丧葬一条街多了几分畏惧，平时路过那都要绕一圈。

这会正是凌晨一点多，几人光是听到那街的名字就一阵毛骨悚然，谁还敢接这单啊，不要命啦！
一瞬间，围绕在林熙跟前的司机们就散开了，还不时用古怪和防备的眼神看着她。
林熙倒是也不在意，视线扫过停着的车，忽然走向最末尾的那一辆。
轻扣车门，她冲驾驶座的司机开口。
“丧葬一条街，走吗？”
司机名叫丁鹏，闻言一愣，不确定的询问。
“小姑娘，你真要去丧葬一条街？那里晚上可去不得啊。”
林熙没有追问为什么，想了想，干脆改口道：“你把我送到那附近就行。”
丧葬一条街附近有几个小区，但因为规模不大，再加上丧葬一条街的“名声”
太响，倒是偶尔有人会不清楚具体地址只说去丧葬一条街附近。
丁鹏便以为林熙也是如此，心下松了一口气。
而且巧的是，他家也就在那附近，且就在丧葬一条街隔壁。
就是没想到他都打算收车回家了，还能拉到一单顺路的生意。
不过就算是没有林熙，丁鹏也是要往那边走的，所以在收取费用的时候，他打算一会只收个油费算了，然后把林熙放在他家小区门口，小区门卫室二十四小时有人值班，也能看着她点。

Chapter 3 Crying at night
"If you don't want to go, go find someone else."
"If you don't leave, who can go there this late at night?"
Do you think you have a long life or are you unlucky enough?
Funeral Street, also called Nanqing Street, is a famous "weird" street in Jiangyu City.
street.
In the early years, everyone called it Funeral Street, because the whole street was famous for being filled with shops selling all kinds of funeral supplies. There were also several Feng Shui shops on the street, and people who needed various products and services were used to going there, so the shops on the street were doing pretty well.
But starting three years ago, weird things began to happen on the funeral street.
During the day, everything is fine, people are doing business, and people are buying things. But at night, there will be some events on the street that cannot be explained by science.
For example, there would be inexplicable cries on the street at night. When the shopkeepers who lived on the street came out to check, there was no one on the street, and even the surveillance cameras couldn't take pictures.
There will be a woman in a white dress walking on the street in the evening, but that woman has no feet.
The scented candles in the store always disappear in the middle of the night...
In short, all kinds of strange things happened, and the merchants on the street were also scared. They moved out soon. Those who really couldn't bear to do this business only sold things during the day, and closed their doors as soon as it got dark.
But even though nothing happened during the day, the street gradually emptied out. Now only a few shops near the street entrance are still open, but there is no business.
It’s less popular and the whole street looks eerie during the day.
Gradually, the locals have a common understanding, that is, you should never go to the funeral street if you have nothing to do, especially at night!
This group of drivers has a night motorcade chat group. There used to be a bold driver in the group who did not believe in evil and insisted on going to that street to explore at night. As a result, he drove in at eight or nine in the evening and did not drive out until dawn the next day.
You must know that Funeral Street is only a straight street only a few hundred meters long, and the road is gentle. It only takes less than a minute to drive from the street to the end of the street during the day. However, the driver drove the whole night without even driving out. It was only at dawn the next day that he realized that the exit was right in front of him.
After driving all night, I ran out of gas and was so frightened that I had to rest at home for more than half a month before I recovered.
After this incident, drivers became even more afraid of the funeral street, and usually had to go around it when passing by.
It was just after one o'clock in the morning. Just hearing the name of that street made several people feel horrified. Who dares to take this order? It's a life-threatening situation!
In an instant, the drivers surrounding Lin Xi dispersed, looking at her with strange and defensive eyes from time to time.
Lin Xi didn't care. She glanced across the parked cars and suddenly walked towards the one at the end.
She opened the car door lightly and spoke to the driver in the driver's seat.
"Funeral Street, do you want to go?"
The driver's name was Ding Peng. Hearing this, he was stunned and asked uncertainly.
"Little girl, do you really want to go to the funeral street? You can't go there at night."
Lin Xi didn't ask why. After thinking about it, she simply changed her words and said, "Just send me to that place."
There are several communities near Funeral Street, but because of their small size and the "fame" of Funeral Street,
It's too loud, but occasionally someone will not know the specific address and just say it's near the funeral street.
Ding Peng thought that Lin Xi was like this too, and he breathed a sigh of relief.
And coincidentally, his home is also nearby, and right next to the funeral street.
I just didn't expect that he was going to collect the car and go home, and still get a piece of business.
But even without Lin Xi, Ding Peng still had to go there, so when collecting the fee, he planned to just charge the gas fee for a while, and then put Lin Xi at the door of his community. The community guard office was on duty 24 hours a day, so he could keep an eye on her.Chapter 3 Crying at night
